name: ml_search_models
description: Research pretrained models on the Hugging Face Hub ('find me a small sentiment model', 'what models are there for tweets?'). Returns real model cards (task, parameters, licence, downloads, weight size, last update) each checked against what Albie's trainer can fine-tune, and one recommended pick with its reasons; the cards stream onto the ML desk's Research panel. Models the trainer can't fine-tune (image, generative, speech) are marked browse only. Say the pick and its main reason in one sentence, then offer to fine-tune it; only after a yes, call ml_new with base_model set to the pick's id. On-device latency is not measured: don't quote one.

query.description: what to look for, in a few words ('sentiment', 'distilbert', 'news topics')

task.description: text_classification (the default), image_classification, object_detection, speech_recognition, text_generation, or a Hugging Face task tag

name: ml_search_datasets
description: Research datasets on the Hugging Face Hub ('find a dataset of movie reviews'). Returns real dataset cards (task tags, size, licence, downloads, access) checked against what ml_new can train, and one recommended pick. Say the pick and why in one sentence; ml_new takes its id as dataset.

query.description: what the data is about, in a few words

task.description: only if the user was clear about text or images
